name: Pyramid Club

name: New York

name: RuPaul

name: Randy Barbato
context: Co-host. He holds up The Drag Explosion for the viewers and calls it a great accomplishment

name: Tabboo!
context: Linda called him about a Pyramid float for the 1986 Pride parade; he suggested the name Linda. James calls him her mentor

name: Linda Simpson
context: Guest. Drag queen, zine maker and party host from Minnesota; her snapshots of 1987-1995 drag became the slideshow and book The Drag Explosion

name: Club Kids

name: Lady Bunny

name: Wigstock

name: East Village
